portInfo.description: Acapulco’s cruise gateway is the downtown Puerto Transatlántico Internacional Teniente José Azueta, marketed by Global Ports Holding as Acapulco Cruise Port after a 24-year concession with ASIPONA Acapulco signed April 2026, with GPH operations beginning in Q2 2026. GPH publishes one berth with 406 m berthing line, maximum ship length 333 m, draught 9.1 m and quay depth 9 m. In parallel, ASIPONA is constructing a new 350-meter cruise pier funded publicly and scheduled for completion in Q1 2027. ASIPONA Acapulco’s site lists Av Costera Miguel Alemán s/n, Centro, and recent news of Carnival Firenze and Holland America Eurodam calls. Passenger door WGS84 pins are not published — null.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Acapulco Cruise Port (Puerto Transatlántico Internacional Teniente José Azueta) — Av Costera Miguel Alemán s/n, Col. Acapulco de Juárez Centro, 39300 Acapulco de Juárez, Gro. (ASIPONA office framing)

thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
